versions.changelog:
Initial release: Enables atomic swap trading of inscriptions and NFTs on EVM chains using HTLCs.

- Supports peer-to-peer, trustless trades (no intermediaries) for NFTs and digital assets.
- Covers major chains: Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, and other EVM-compatible networks.
- Includes CLI commands for generating preimages, locking funds, and completing trades.
- Provides clear flow for atomic, escrowless swaps using hashes and time locks.
